exercises.name: Light Marching in Place
exercises.visual_guide: Stand tall, lift knees gently to hip height alternately, swinging arms smoothly at your sides.

exercises.name: Arm Circles
exercises.visual_guide: Extend arms out to sides at shoulder height; make medium circles (30s forward, 30s backward).

exercises.name: Gentle Torso Twists
exercises.visual_guide: Stand with feet wide, hands near chest; gently rotate torso left and right, letting hips follow slightly.

visual_guide.start: Place hands shoulder-width on chair seat, body in a plank position from head to heels.
visual_guide.action: Lower chest slowly toward chair edge (inhale); push firmly back to starting position (exhale).

visual_guide.start: Stand facing away from chair, feet shoulder-width apart, arms extended forward for balance.
visual_guide.action: Hinge hips back and lower down until glutes lightly tap the chair seat; drive through heels to stand.

visual_guide.start: Lie flat on mat, knees bent, feet flat on floor hip-width apart, arms at sides.
visual_guide.action: Press through heels, squeeze glutes, and lift hips toward ceiling until thighs and torso line up; lower down with control.

visual_guide.start: Position on mat on hands and knees (quadruped stance), spine neutral.
visual_guide.action: Extend right arm forward and left leg straight back until parallel to floor; hold steady for 15–20s while breathing. Switch sides.

exercises.name: Standing Chest Opener
exercises.visual_guide: Clasp hands behind lower back, pull shoulders back and down, gently lifting chest upward. Hold for 30s.

exercises.name: Standing Quadriceps Stretch
exercises.visual_guide: Stand near chair for balance; pull one ankle back toward glutes, keeping knees aligned. Hold 30s per leg.
